ideas.title: Add a focused accessibility review checklist for preview screens
ideas.goal: Make accessibility checks repeatable without claiming current defects.
ideas.rationale: The repository documents that app test sources are absent; a bounded manual checklist can record evidence before UI behavior changes.
successCriteria: Checklist covers labels, text scaling, contrast, focus/order, and touch targets for each existing screen.
Findings include screen and reproducible steps; no unsupported accessibility claim is recorded.
sideEffects: Documents test scope but does not verify or modify app accessibility.

evidence.excerpt:
Es gibt keine Android-Testquellen; ein `NO-SOURCE`-Testtask ist kein bestandener
Unit-Test.

ideas.title: Run backend contract tests in a bounded CI job
ideas.goal: Catch contract regressions automatically without invoking Android builds twice.
ideas.rationale: Android CI is documented around APK build and verification; the backend README documents a local contract-test command, making CI ownership a candidate to investigate rather than a proven global CI gap.
successCriteria: CI runs the standard-library contract test suite once per relevant change.
The CI job does not access secrets, production endpoints, external services, or perform deployment.
dependencies: Choose whether the existing Android workflow or a separate Python workflow owns the test.
sideEffects: May add CI runtime and workflow maintenance; no extra Android build should be introduced.

ideas.title: Implement consent-based cross-device session transfer
ideas.goal: Allow a user-approved, scoped session continuation between separately installed apps.
ideas.rationale: The transfer is currently a proposal; identity, transport, action scope, key lifecycle, and security acceptance criteria are unresolved.
successCriteria: Only explicitly approved source and target installations can participate.
Replay, wrong-app scope, stale consent, revocation, and reconnection without fresh authentication are rejected.
SecurityChain-P0 and physical-device acceptance are documented and pass before production release.
dependencies: Written SecurityChain-P0 criteria and owner approval.
Approved threat model, identity, transport, key lifecycle, consent text, and data scope.
Separate reviews in both app repositories.
sideEffects: Would create new security-sensitive cross-device data flows and operational obligations.

evidence.excerpt:
Die Planung ist abgeschlossen; die Implementierung bleibt **BLOCKED**, bis
SecurityChain-P0-Nachweis, Bedrohungsmodell, fachlicher Daten-/Aktionsumfang,
Transportwahl und Protokollvertrag freigegeben sind.

ideas.title: Add a runtime-detected LiDAR/depth sensor plugin
ideas.goal: Expose only verified, user-approved sensor-derived summaries on compatible devices.
ideas.rationale: No sensor runtime or supported-device evidence exists; a generic Android depth capability must not be represented as LiDAR support.
successCriteria: A plugin reports a sensor only after runtime provider/capability detection.
Capture requires both applicable OS permission and explicit purpose-specific user consent.
Raw sensor data remains local and unsupported devices expose no fabricated capability.
dependencies: Approved sensor purpose, permission UX, local processing, and retention policy.
Written SecurityChain-P0 approval and physical-device testing.
sideEffects: Would require new sensor permissions, privacy review, device-specific testing, and retention controls.

evidence.excerpt: Android hat keine universelle LiDAR-Gerätegarantie/API im bestehenden Vertrag.
